Name: First Farmhouse Renovation
Author: K3vinLevin
Description:
With this mod you can have a kitchen in the farmhouse and multiplayer cabins, you also have the option to add a basement.

[s]Only modify the farmhouse without an upgrade, if you have it in the first upgrade it will no longer work, unless it is modified, maybe I will try to do this in the future[/s]. [b]This mod modifies the first farmhouse without upgrade and the first upgraded farmhouse![/b] 

I made this mod for personal use on my multiplayer farm with my girlfriend, since we use my house (host), to take advantage of the space I decided to make a basement in her house, then I had the idea of ​​adding a kitchen for decoration, but it's fully functional

It's totally compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]generic mod config menu[/url], [s]although it only has the option "basement: true/false"[/s]. [b]Now it has 3 choices for basement: always, only on upgrade or never.
[/b]













I was a little inspired by this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4623]Cabins as Sheds[/url] mod

Downloads.Description: This version adds support for the first farmhouse upgrade.
